title: Stone2 솔로 #25 · super hourglass · 석재 jade · 야외 테라스 · 코랄 립
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, blunt bob chestnut brown hair — full body polished jade-green stone fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep jade-green stone surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID pale-green cloudy vein striations flowing through every section, with mother-of-pearl flowers inlaid into the sections, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: both hands resting on her thighs, leaning slightly forward, one knee bent — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the jade-green stone body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left calf, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her left upper arm and one at her right forearm, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw grey-green stone with a rough waxy surface, much duller than the polished jade outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the jade-green stone is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, ankle-strap platform stiletto pumps in glossy black patent leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved jade-green stone right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, carved from the same jade with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque satin vivid orange-coral red lips, peach-gold eyeshadow, defined lashes, a warm blush. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved jade-green stone.

Background: a sunlit open-air stone terrace at midday with a pale paved floor, a waist-high balustrade, potted palms and a full-height wooden door behind her, bright blue sky overhead, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
